title: Ly Gayi Aye Rida Zainab
body:
Ly Gayi Aye Rida Zainab Di Ghazi Vi Leh Gaya
Haye Shaam De Safaran Layi Dukhiyaari Bibi Da Aik Abid Baaqi Reh Gayi
Noor De Waire Ch Jairi Noori Burqa Paa Ke
Kadhi Turdi Naye Si
Haaye Baaj Bhirawan De Pathran De Khaaran Te
Onu Pehdal Turhna Paye Gaya
Jinnu Akbar Ton Vi Pehle Ali Akbar Di Tarha
Paal Di Rayi Zainab
Oh Veer Juda Hoya Fir Jundiyan Zainab Layi
Aik Hasrat Ban Ke Reh Gaya
Apni Qaid Laye Zainab Aik Waari Jeena
Ro Saki Qaidaan Wich
Har Waari Rondi Rayi Ona Teeran Nu Jhere
Akhiyan Wich Ghazi Seh Gaya
